exposure: treatment strategies (hysterectomy and bilateral adnexectomy with or without adjuvant therapy, lesion resection only)
cohort: The study included eight patients diagnosed with PEComa (seven with uterine tumors, one with pelvic cavity tumor) who were treated at the Gynecology Department of The West China Second University Hospital of Sichuan University between May 2018 and January 2024.
finding: The study found that complete lesion resection is crucial for PEComa, as inadequate treatment significantly increases the risks of recurrence and metastasis.
